description: Observation Concept model organised around the abstract 'Recording' tree. Generic, study-independent concepts are the node identities; SDTM variables are aliases bound via 'is a' relationships; FHIR R5 complex datatypes model the value branch; USDM Biomedical Concept properties resolve onto the nodes. Covers Findings, Events and Interventions.

principleSource.title: Build Definitions — the abstract Recording structure
principleSource.author: data4knowledge ApS
principleSource.principle: An abstract 'Recording' tree (Topic, DateTime, Result→Quantity|Coded, qualifiers) is defined once; concrete definitions (Biomedical Concepts / SDTM dataset specializations) INHERIT it and CONSTRAIN it. Node concepts link to SDTM variables via 'is a' relationships.

sourceGrounding._note: Every binding in this model derives from CDISC source metadata, not hardcoded values.
sourceGrounding.sdtmModel: model/SDTM_v2.0.csv — Class/Role backbone (Topic, Timing, Identifier, qualifier roles).
sourceGrounding.specializations: model/cdisc_sdtm_dataset_specializations_latest.xlsx — relationship graph: sdtm_variable -[linking_phrase / predicate_term]-> Topic, carrying dec_id (cross-domain generic concept C-code).
sourceGrounding.usdm: USDM BiomedicalConcept.properties[].code.standardCode.code = dec_id; property name = SDTM variable alias; responseCodes = value-set constraint.

valueTypes._note: FHIR-aligned value type vocabulary. Complex types model observation values; primitive types model method constraints and statistical concepts.

decimal.usage: Continuous measurements (AVAL, lab results, scores, durations)

code.definition: String value from a defined value set

Quantity.definition: Measured amount with unit of measurement
Quantity.usage: Numeric clinical values — measurements, scores, durations, doses, concentrations

CodeableConcept.definition: Concept defined by one or more code systems
CodeableConcept.usage: Categorical clinical values — coded responses, treatment arms, severity grades

Period.definition: Time range defined by a start and end dateTime
Period.usage: Interval timing — the span of an event or intervention (--STDTC to --ENDTC)

Recording.definition: The atomic abstract act of recording one fact about a subject. Root of the observation tree. Every General Observation Class (Finding, Event, Intervention) inherits this spine.

nodeBindingShape._note: Every node may carry: valueType (FHIR), relationship + linkingPhrase + predicateTerm (xlsx graph), decConcepts (generic cross-domain C-codes), aliases (SDTM variable patterns — the 'is a' links), appliesToClass, and usdmBinding.

spine._note: Truly universal across all General Observation Classes — every class has a Topic, a DateTime and the shared qualifiers.

Identity.definition: The identity of the record and its subject

Sequence.definition: Ordinal position distinguishing multiple records of the same topic for a subject

GroupId.definition: Identifier grouping related records for a subject within a domain

ReferenceId.definition: Identifier of a source of information (e.g. lab specimen ID, waveform UUID)

LinkId.definition: Identifier linking a record to one or more records in another domain

Topic.definition: Core subject matter of the recording — a test (Finding), an event term (Event), or a treatment (Intervention).
Topic._note: The Topic role is universal across General Observation Classes; only the SDTM alias and the decode pair differ by class.

TopicCode.definition: Short coded form of the topic
TopicCode.linkingPhrase: is the code for the value in

TopicDecode.definition: Human-readable decode of the topic code

HierarchyLevel.definition: Level in dictionary tree (SOC, HLT, PT, LLT)

Timing.definition: When the recording occurred. Modelled as a FHIR effective[x] choice: an instant (point-in-time) or a period (interval). --DTC and --STDTC are the SAME occurrence/start concept (both carry dec_id C82515); only --ENDTC is distinct (the period end).

effective.definition: The occurrence time — a choice of instant or period. The point-vs-interval split mirrors the class split (Finding = instant; Event/Intervention = period).
effective.linkingPhrase: is the date of occurrence for

instant.definition: Point-in-time occurrence (typical for Findings) — FHIR effectiveDateTime

period.definition: Interval occurrence (typical for Events and Interventions) — FHIR effectivePeriod

Duration.definition: Elapsed time of the period (derived from start/end)

values.Relative: Day relative to reference event (--DY, ADY)

RelativeTiming.definition: Timing relative to a reference event or timepoint

sharedQualifiers._note: Qualifier concepts whose linking_phrase recurs across multiple General Observation Classes. Each is the abstract identity for the SDTM variables listed as aliases.

Method.definition: Instrument or technique used to perform the test
Method.linkingPhrase: is the method for the test in

Location.definition: Anatomical site at which the observation was performed
Location.linkingPhrase: specifies the anatomical location of the performance of the test in

Laterality.definition: Side of the body (left, right, bilateral)
Laterality.linkingPhrase: further specifies the anatomical location in

Directionality.definition: Directional qualifier of the anatomical location
Directionality.linkingPhrase: further specifies the anatomical location in

EvaluatorRole.definition: Role of the assessor who performed the test
EvaluatorRole.linkingPhrase: is the role of the assessor who performed the test in

Position.definition: Subject position during performance of the test
Position.linkingPhrase: was the subject position during performance of the test in

FastingStatus.definition: Subject's fasting status during the test
FastingStatus.linkingPhrase: is the subject's fasting status during the performance of the test in

valuePattern._note: A reusable datatype shape the spine offers — NOT a universal slot. Class-specific characterizing nodes (Finding.Result, Intervention.Dose, Event.Severity) instantiate it.

ResultValue.definition: The observed value of a characterizing node. Resolves to a Quantity (numeric + unit) or a Coded value.

Quantity.definition: Numeric value with a unit of measurement (FHIR Quantity)

value.linkingPhrase: is the result of the test in

code(units).definition: Coded unit of measurement for the value
code(units).linkingPhrase: is the unit for the value in
code(units)._note: USDM may carry a more specific semantic unit code (e.g. C49669 'Unit of Pressure'); the --ORRESU alias still resolves the node.

Coded.definition: Categorical value from a code system (FHIR CodeableConcept)

code.linkingPhrase: is the result of the test in

observationClasses._note: Each General Observation Class inherits the Recording spine and binds its own characterizing node(s) to the ResultValue pattern. This is the hybrid of one polymorphic spine + class-specific value branches.

Finding.definition: A measurement, test or examination (lab, vital sign, ECG, questionnaire).

Result.definition: The outcome of the test — answers the Topic question.
Result.linkingPhrase: is the result of the test in

Reference.linkingPhrase: is a reference range value for

Event.definition: An occurrence or incident independent of planned study evaluations (adverse event, medical history, disposition).
Event._note: Events have NO --ORRES. The characterizing value is occurrence/severity/outcome — not a test result.

Occurrence.linkingPhrase: indicates occurrence of the value in

PreSpecified.definition: Whether the event term was pre-specified on the CRF
PreSpecified.linkingPhrase: indicates pre-specification of the value in

Seriousness.definition: Whether the event met seriousness criteria (SAE)

Outcome.definition: How the event resolved (recovered, ongoing, fatal)

ActionTaken.definition: Action taken with study treatment due to the event

Intervention.definition: An investigational, therapeutic or other treatment intentionally administered (exposure, concomitant medication, procedure, substance use).
Intervention._note: Interventions have NO --ORRES. The characterizing value is the administered Dose — a Quantity (value + unit).

Dose.linkingPhrase: is the administered amount of the treatment in

Frequency.definition: How often the amount is administered (QD, BID)
Frequency.linkingPhrase: is the frequency of administration of the amount in

DoseForm.definition: Physical form of the product (tablet, injection)
DoseForm.linkingPhrase: is the physical form of the product in

Route.linkingPhrase: is the part of the body through which is administered the treatment in

Indication.definition: Medical condition that is the reason for the treatment
Indication.linkingPhrase: is the medical condition that is the reason for the treatment in

sharedDimensions._note: Cross-cutting context shared by all recordings, independent of class.

Timepoint._note: Planned timepoint label; the actual occurrence time is Recording.spine.Timing.

buildDefinition._note: Tier 2. A BuildDefinition INHERITS the abstract Recording and CONSTRAINS it. A BuildDefinition IS a USDM BiomedicalConcept.
buildDefinition.definition: A concrete, study-independent concept (e.g. Systolic Blood Pressure) that inherits the Recording tree, selects a value branch, fixes value sets, and sets the Topic term.

constraintOperations.selectBranch: Choose Quantity or Coded under a characterizing node; disable the other (the slide's red ✗).
constraintOperations.fixValueSet: Constrain a node's permissible values (responseCodes) — e.g. units {C,F}; sizes {small,medium,large}.
constraintOperations.enableQualifiers: Mark which inherited qualifier nodes are active (isEnabled).

usdmMapping._note: How a USDM BiomedicalConcept resolves onto this model.
usdmMapping.BiomedicalConcept.extensionAttributes[sd: → the SDTM dataset specialization (the build definition link)
usdmMapping.BiomedicalConceptProperty.name: → resolves to a node by SDTM alias pattern (e.g. VSLOC → --LOC → Location)
usdmMapping.BiomedicalConceptProperty.code.standardC: → resolves to a node by decConcepts (e.g. C13717 → Location)
usdmMapping.BiomedicalConceptProperty.responseCodes: → the fixValueSet constraint on the node
usdmMapping.resolutionRule: A property binds to a node when its name matches the node alias pattern OR its standardCode matches the node decConcepts. The two keys cross-check.
